# Psalm 127 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 127:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Vain for-you rising-early, sitting-late, eating bread-of toil; so he-gives to-his-beloved sleep.
- **LOGOS:** It is in vain that you rise up early and go late to rest, eating the bread of anxious toil; for he gives to his beloved sleep.
- **PNEUMA:** It's pointless to get up early and stay up late, slaving away anxiously — God gives rest to those he loves.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** Like-arrows in-hand-of a-warrior, so the-sons-of youth.
- **LOGOS:** Like arrows in the hand of a warrior are the children of one's youth.
- **PNEUMA:** Children born to a young parent are like arrows in a warrior's hand.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 127:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Blessed the-man who has-filled his-quiver with-them; not they-will-be-ashamed when-they-speak with enemies in-the-gate.
- **LOGOS:** Blessed is the man who fills his quiver with them! He shall not be put to shame when he speaks with his enemies in the gate.
- **PNEUMA:** How happy is the person whose quiver is full of them! They won't be intimidated when they face their opponents in court.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 127:1 (overlap: 4%)

- **EMET:** A-song of-the-ascents. Of-Solomon. If YHWH not builds the-house, in-vain labor its-builders in-it; if YHWH not guards the-city, in-vain watches the-watchman.
- **LOGOS:** A Song of Ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, those who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.
- **PNEUMA:** A song for the journey to Jerusalem. By Solomon. If the LORD doesn't build the house, the builders are wasting their time. If the LORD doesn't guard the city, the watchman is staying up for nothing.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 127:3 (overlap: 8%)

- **EMET:** Behold an-inheritance-of YHWH children; a-reward the-fruit-of the-womb.
- **LOGOS:** Behold, children are a heritage from the LORD, the fruit of the womb a reward.
- **PNEUMA:** Children are a gift from the LORD — the fruit of the womb is his reward.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
